item.title: DOGE Hackers Still Unable to Locate Josh Hawley's Wife's Clit For Him
item.description: Sen. Hawley still has faith in Co-President Musk's team of hackers at DOGE, despite some disappointing personal setbacks they caused him.

item.title: Saying "Gulf of America" is How Pedophiles Are Identifying Each Other Now
item.description: Groups that are trying to fly under the radar often use secret code phrases to identify one another. Thanks to a new executive order, pedos have a new code phrase to use.

item.title: Obama Dares Co-Presidents to Attempt His Record for Holding Their Breath Underwater
item.description: President Obama has challenged the current president(s) to a competition of physical fitness. Will either man accept?

item.title: Marjorie Taylor Greene Says Greenland "Would Be Lucky" if Trump Ran It Like One of His Casinos
item.description: The Georgian native says if President Donald Trump gets ahold of Greenland, she'd lobby him to be made its permanent supreme ruler.

item.title: Greenlander Would Rather Not Lose Universal Healthcare to Join "Shit Hole" Country
item.description: She's quite content for her country to remain under the stewardship of Denmark, who provides its citizens with healthcare like a developed country does.

item.title: His Plastic Surgeon Told Me Elon's Pronouns Are "Closet Case"
item.description: We spoke to Co-President Musk's plastic surgeon, who told us what the billionaire's preferred pronouns are.

item.title: I Can't Afford Groceries, But I Bought a Cybertruck Because Libs Are Mean to Elon
item.description: Out of loyalty to both presidents, singer/songwriter/podcaster Jethro Bohiggins is the proud owner of a new Cybertruck he absolutely cannot afford.

item.title: Trump Orders Every American to Buy Six Teslas
item.description: He wants to help his co-president's car company's flagging sales and tanking stock price, so Trump ordered you to buy six Teslas.

item.title: Texas Woman Identifies as Tesla Dealership So Government Will Protect Her Rights
item.description: She'd like her rights protected, too, so she's now identifying as a Tesla dealership. Will the Texas government allow it?

item.title: Why Did The Secretary of Defense Text Me Dick Pics and Nuclear Launch Codes?
item.description: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth sent me lewd images and nuclear launch codes, and I just wanted to understand why.
